visual_action: A cutout of Donald Trump speaking and gesturing is superimposed over a static image of the U.S. Capitol building under a partly cloudy sky. An American flag is visible to the right of the Capitol dome.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown as a cutout speaking for the entire duration of the video, and his voice is the only audio besides the background music.

cast.name: Republicans
cast.evidence: The on-screen text explicitly names 'Republicans' as the subject of the video's claim.

on_screen_text.text: Republicans taking credit for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law after voting against it...

spoken_summary: Donald Trump says, "Somebody had to do it. I am the chosen one. Somebody had to do it."
audio_music: A dramatic, slightly tense instrumental track, identified as 'X' by SdotK, plays under the dialogue.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot featuring a superimposed figure over a background image.
manipulation_or_satire: Donald Trump is digitally cut out from a different context and superimposed over a background image of the U.S. Capitol building. This creates a fabricated scene to pair his audio with the text's message about Republicans.
central_claim: Republicans are hypocritically taking credit for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law after they voted against it.
intended_effect: To portray Republicans as hypocritical and self-serving.
